elaine: Heads up — we rolled the continuous-batching heuristic at 03:14 UTC and saw a P95 latency bump on prod-rt for short requests. P50 unaffected, but P95 jumped from ~120ms to ~260ms for requests with <=64 tokens. Rolling back now. Anyone catch kernel selection / queue anomalies?

max: I pulled a few traces. The selector started favoring gpu_int8_kernel_v3 for many tiny batches (shape 1x<=32). The chosen kernel has higher launch overhead for these shapes. Sample: 
```text
[2026-03-15T03:14:21Z] selector: chosen kernel gpu_int8_kernel_v3 (shape=1x32)
kernel_launch: 1.9ms
kv_lookup: 0.3ms
total_token_time: 5.2ms
```

sam: Queue snapshots show a ton of 1-2 item microbatches. The new heuristic increased token_budget_target from 64 -> 128 in the attempt to improve throughput, so the batcher delays drains to hit the larger token budget which lengthens tail latency for small interactive calls.

raj: KV cache hit rate looks stable but we see increased KV serialization contention on worker threads. My hunch: holding requests longer to hit token budget increases concurrent access to per-worker KV locks, adding small delays.

elaine: Rollback completed at 03:18 UTC — metrics returning to baseline. We need RCA. Immediate mitigation ideas: prefer small-batch kernel when batch_size <= 4 or add a per-shape kernel cost model to the selector.

max: Agreed. Also propose a canary experiment: prefer small-kernel for avg_seq_len < 32 && batch_size <= 4. I'll put up a flagged change (canary flag: small-kernel-pref).

sam: Can we also classify endpoints as "interactive" and lower token_budget_target per-class? The global 128 is too aggressive for chatty endpoints.

infra-bot: rollback by elaine at 2026-03-15T03:18:12Z recorded (deploy-id: deploy-rt-20260315-1147).

raj: Logging follow-up: add kernel_selection_debug that emits chosen_kernel + batch_shape + token_budget_at_drain for 1% of requests to traces so we can correlate.

max: Quick profiling note: the main extra time was kernel launch + padding when selector mismatched expected shape, and occasional device-side kernel warmup for int8 path. Short-term fix: short-circuit to small-kernel path for microbatches.

elaine: I created ticket INF-6423: "heuristic: token-budget increase causing kernel mismatch & latency tail". Assigned to eng-runtime; I'll add perf graphs, sample traces, and a copy of this thread.

sam: ACK. Thanks for the quick rollback and notes. :thumbsup:

max: I'll own the small-kernel pref experiment and the kernel cost model prototype.

elaine: Thanks — let's aim for a canary today and add the extra tracing.

raj: Also recommend a post-deploy checklist entry: when tuning token_budget_target, run microbench for batch_size in {1,2,4,8} and confirm selector doesn't flip to higher-overhead kernels for tiny shapes.

perf-ci: perf-test matrix queued: will run shapes [1,2,4] x seq_len [8,16,32] against gpu_int8_kernel_v3 and small_kernel_v1 and report latency/throughput deltas.

elaine: Perfect. Ping me if you need quick access to prod traces.

max: reassign INF-6423 to me for the kernel-selection part.

elaine: thx everyone.
